sections.label: The glorification of Rohita, a form of Fire and of the Sun
sections.name: Book 13, hymn 1

verses.sa:
उदेहि वाजिन् यो अप्स्व१न्तरिदं राष्ट्रं प्र विश सूनृतावत्।
यो रोहितो विश्वमिदं जजान स त्वा राष्ट्राय सुभृतं बिभर्तु॥
verses.tr: udehi vājin yo apsva1ntaridaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pra viśa sūnṛtāvat yo rohito viśvamidaṃ jajāna sa tvā rāṣṭrāya subhṛtaṃ bibhartu
verses.en: Rise, Mighty One, who liest in the waters, and enter this thy fair and glorious kingdom, Let Rohita who made this All uphold thee carefully nurtured for supreme dominion.

verses.sa:
उद् वाज आ गन् यो अप्स्व१न्तर्विश आ रोह त्वद्योनयो याः ।
सोमं दधानोऽप ओषधीर्गाश्चतुष्पदो द्विपद आ वेशयेह॥
verses.tr: ud vāja ā gan yo apsva1ntarviśa ā roha tvadyonayo yāḥ somaṃ dadhāno'pa oṣadhīrgāścatuṣpado dvipada ā veśayeha
verses.en: The strength that was in waters hath ascended, Mount o'er the tribes which thou hast generated, Creating Soma, waters, plants and cattle, bring hitherward both quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa:
यूयमुग्रा मरुतः पृश्निमातर इन्द्रेण युजा प्र मृणीत शत्रून्।
आ वो रोहितः शृणवत् सुदानवस्त्रिषप्तासो मरुतः स्वादुसंमुदः॥
verses.tr: yūyamugrā marutaḥ pṛśnimātara indreṇa yujā pra mṛṇīta śatrūn ā vo rohitaḥ śṛṇavat sudānavastriṣaptāso marutaḥ svādusaṃmudaḥ
verses.en: Ye Maruts, strong and mighty, sons of Prisni, with Indra for ally crush down our foemen. Let Rohita, ye bounteous givers, hear you, thrice-seven Maruts who delight in sweetness!

verses.sa:
रुहो रुरोह रोहित आ रुरोह गर्भो जनीनां जनुषामुपस्थम्।
ताभिः संरब्धमन्वविन्दन् षडुर्वीर्गातुं प्रपश्यन्निह राष्ट्रमाहाः॥
verses.tr: ruho ruroha rohita ā ruroha garbho janīnāṃ januṣāmupastham tābhiḥ saṃrabdhamanvavindan ṣaḍurvīrgātuṃ prapaśyanniha rāṣṭramāhāḥ
verses.en: Up to the lap of births, to lofty places, hath Rohita, the germ of Dames, ascended, Conjoined with these he found the six realms: seeing his way in front here he received the kingship,

verses.sa:
आ ते राष्ट्रमिह रोहितोऽहार्षीद् व्याऽस्थन्मृधो अभयं ते अभूत्।
तस्मै ते द्यावापृथिवी रेवतीभिः कामं दुहातामिह शक्वरीभिः॥
verses.tr: ā te rāṣṭramiha rohito'hārṣīd vyā'sthanmṛdho abhayaṃ te abhūt tasmai te dyāvāpṛthivī revatībhiḥ kāmaṃ duhātāmiha śakvarībhiḥ
verses.en: For thee hath Rohita obtained dominion, scattered thine enemies, become thy safeguard. So by the potent Sakvaris let Heaven and Earth be milked to yield thee all thy wishes,

verses.sa:
रोहितो द्यावापृथिवी जजान तत्र तन्तुं परमेष्ठी ततान ।
तत्र शिश्रियेऽज एकपादोऽदृंहद् द्यावापृथिवी बलेन॥
verses.tr: rohito dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna tatra tantuṃ parameṣṭhī tatāna tatra śiśriye'ja ekapādo'dṛṃhad dyāvāpṛthivī balena
verses.en: Rohita gave the Earth and Heavens their being. There Parameshthin held the cord extended. Thereon reposeth Aja Ekapada, He with his might hath stablished Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
रोहितो द्यावापृथिवी अदृंहत् तेन स्वऽ स्तभितं तेन नाकः ।
तेनान्तरिक्षं विमिता रजांसि तेन देवा अमृतमन्वविन्दन्॥
verses.tr: rohito dyāvāpṛthivī adṛṃhat tena sva' stabhitaṃ tena nākaḥ tenāntarikṣaṃ vimitā rajāṃsi tena devā amṛtamanvavindan
verses.en: Rohita firmly stablished Earth and Heaven: by him was ether fixt, by him the welkin, He measured out mid-air and all the regions: by him the Gods found life that lasts for ever.

verses.sa:
वि रोहितो अमृशद् विश्वरूपं समाकुर्वाणः प्ररुहो रुहश्च ।
दिवं रूढ्वा महता महिम्ना सं ते राष्ट्रमनक्तु पयसा घृतेन॥
verses.tr: vi rohito amṛśad viśvarūpaṃ samākurvāṇaḥ praruho ruhaśca divaṃ rūḍhvā mahatā mahimnā saṃ te rāṣṭramanaktu payasā ghṛtena
verses.en: Arranging shoots, springs, Rohita considered this Universe in all its forms and phases, May he, gone up to heaven with mighty glory, anoint thy sovranty with milk and fatness,

verses.sa:
यास्ते रुहः प्ररुहो यास्त आरुहो याभिरापृणासि दिवमन्तरिक्षम्।
तासां ब्रह्मणा पयसा ववृधानो विशि राष्ट्रे जागृहि रोहितस्य॥
verses.tr: yāste ruhaḥ praruho yāsta āruho yābhirāpṛṇāsi divamantarikṣam tāsāṃ brahmaṇā payasā vavṛdhāno viśi rāṣṭre jāgṛhi rohitasya
verses.en: Thy risings up, thy mountings and ascensions wherewith thou fillest heaven and air's mid-region—By prayer for these, by milk of these, increasing, in Rohita's kingdom watch, among his people.

verses.sa:
यस्ते विशस्तपसः संबभूवुर्वत्सं गायत्रीमनु ता इहागुः ।
तास्त्वा विशन्तु मनसा शिवेन संमाता वत्सो अभ्येऽतु रोहितः॥
verses.tr: yaste viśastapasaḥ saṃbabhūvurvatsaṃ gāyatrīmanu tā ihāguḥ tāstvā viśantu manasā śivena saṃmātā vatso abhye'tu rohitaḥ
verses.en: The tribes thy heat produced have followed hither the Calf and Gayatri, the strain that lauds him, With friendly heart let them approach to serve thee, and the Calf Rohita come with his mother.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो रोहितो अधि नाके अस्थाद् विश्वा रूपाणि जनयन् युवा कविः ।
तिग्मेनाग्निर्ज्योतिषा वि भाति तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo rohito adhi nāke asthād viśvā rūpāṇi janayan yuvā kaviḥ tigmenāgnirjyotiṣā vi bhāti tṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi
verses.en: I Erected, Rohita hath reached the welkin, wise, young, creating every form and figure, Agni, refulgent with his heightened "lustre, in the third realm hath brough us joy and gladness,

verses.sa:
सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो जातवेदा घृताहुतः सोमपृष्ठः सुवीरः ।
मा मा हासीन्नाथितो नेत् त्वा जहानि गोपोषं च मे वीरपोषं च धेहि॥
verses.tr: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedā ghṛtāhutaḥ somapṛṣṭhaḥ suvīraḥ mā mā hāsīnnāthito net tvā jahāni gopoṣaṃ ca me vīrapoṣaṃ ca dhehi
verses.en: Thousand-horned Bull, may Jatavedas, worshipped with butter, balmed with Soma, rich in heroes, Besought, ne'er quit me; may I ne'er forsake thee, Give me abundant men and herds of cattle,

verses.sa:
रोहितो यज्ञस्य जनिता मुखं च रोहिताय वाचा श्रोत्रेण मनसा जुहोमि ।
रोहितं देवा यन्ति सुमनस्यमानाः स मा रोहैः सामित्यै रोहयतु॥
verses.tr: rohito yajñasya janitā mukhaṃ ca rohitāya vācā śrotreṇa manasā juhomi rohitaṃ devā yanti sumanasyamānāḥ sa mā rohaiḥ sāmityai rohayatu
verses.en: Rohita is the sire and monts of worship: to him with voice, ear, heart I pay oblation, To Rohita come Gods with joyful spirit, May he by risings raise me till I join him,

verses.sa:
रोहितो यज्ञं व्यदधाद् विश्वकर्मणे तस्मात् तेजांस्युप मेमान्यागुः ।
वोचेयं ते नाभिं भुवनस्याधि मज्मनि॥
verses.tr: rohito yajñaṃ vyadadhād viśvakarmaṇe tasmāt tejāṃsyupa memānyāguḥ voceyaṃ te nābhiṃ bhuvanasyādhi majmani
verses.en: Rohita ordered sacrifice for Visvakarman: thence have I obtained this strength and energy, May I proclaim thee as my kin over the greatness of the world. d

verses.sa:
आ त्वा रुरोह बृहत्यू३त पङ्क्तिरा ककुब् वर्चसा जातवेदः ।
आ त्वा रुरोहोष्णिहाक्षरो वषट्कार आ त्वा रुरोह रोहितो रेतसा सह॥
verses.tr: ā tvā ruroha bṛhatyū3ta paṅktirā kakub varcasā jātavedaḥ ā tvā rurohoṣṇihākṣaro vaṣaṭkāra ā tvā ruroha rohito retasā saha
verses.en: On thee have mounted Brihati and Paukti, and Kakup with great splendour, Jatavedas! The cry of Vashat with the voice uplifted and Rohita with seed on thee have mounted.

verses.sa:
अयं वस्ते गर्भं पृथिव्या दिवं वस्तेऽयमन्तरिक्षम्।
अयं ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपि स्वर्लोकान् व्याऽनशे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vaste garbhaṃ pṛthivyā divaṃ vaste'yamantarikṣam ayaṃ bradhnasya viṣṭapi svarlokān vyā'naśe
verses.en: He goes into the womb of earth, he robes himself in heaven and air, He on the Bright One's station hath reached heavenly light and all the worlds.

verses.sa:
वाचस्पते पृथिवी नः स्योना स्योना योनिस्तल्पा नः सुशेवा ।
इहैव प्राणः सख्ये नो अस्तु तं त्वा परमेष्ठिन् पर्यग्निरायुषा वर्चसा दधातु॥
verses.tr: vācaspate pṛthivī naḥ syonā syonā yonistalpā naḥ suśevā ihaiva prāṇaḥ sakhye no astu taṃ tvā parameṣṭhin paryagnirāyuṣā varcasā dadhātu
verses.en: To us, Vachaspati, may Earth be pleasant, pleasant our dwelling, pleasant be our couches. Even here may Prana be our friend: may Agni, O Parameshthin, give thee life and splendour,

verses.sa:
वाचस्पत ऋतवः पञ्च ये नौ वैश्वकर्मणाः परि ये संबभूवुः ।
इहैव प्राणः सख्ये नो अस्तु तं त्वा परमेष्ठिन् परि रोहित आयुषा वर्चसा दधातु॥
verses.tr: vācaspata ṛtavaḥ pañca ye nau vaiśvakarmaṇāḥ pari ye saṃbabhūvuḥ ihaiva prāṇaḥ sakhye no astu taṃ tvā parameṣṭhin pari rohita āyuṣā varcasā dadhātu
verses.en: And thoes, Vachaspati, our own five seasons, sacred to Visvakarman their creator. Even here our friend be Prana: Parameshthin, may Rohita vouchsafe the life and splendour.

verses.sa:
वाचस्पते सौमनसं मनश्च गोष्ठे नो गा जनय योनिषु प्रजाः ।
इहैव प्राणः सख्ये नो अस्तु तं त्वा परमेष्ठिन् पर्यहमायुषा वर्चसा दधातु॥
verses.tr: vācaspate saumanasaṃ manaśca goṣṭhe no gā janaya yoniṣu prajāḥ ihaiva prāṇaḥ sakhye no astu taṃ tvā parameṣṭhin paryahamāyuṣā varcasā dadhātu
verses.en: Breed, O Vachaspati, joy and understanding, kine in our stall and children in our consorts. Even here may Prana be our friend: may Agni, O Parameshthin, give thee life and splendour.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा धात् सविता देवो अग्निर्वर्चसा मित्रावरुणावभि त्वा ।
सर्वा अरातीरवक्रामन्नेहीदं राष्ट्रमकरः सुनृतावत्॥
verses.tr: pari tvā dhāt savitā devo agnirvarcasā mitrāvaruṇāvabhi tvā sarvā arātīravakrāmannehīdaṃ rāṣṭramakaraḥ sunṛtāvat
verses.en: With splendour let God Savitar, and Agni, with splendour Mitra, Varuna invest thee. Treading down all Malignities, come hither. Pleasant and glorious hast thou made this kingdom,

verses.sa: यं त्वा पृषती रथे प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहित । शुभा यासि रिणन्नपः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā pṛṣatī rathe praṣṭirvahati rohita śubhā yāsi riṇannapaḥ
verses.en: Rohita, car-borne by a speckled leader, thou, pouring water, goest on in triumph,

verses.sa:
अनुव्रता रोहिणी रोहितस्य सूरिः सुवर्णा बृहती सुवर्चाः ।
तया वाजान् विश्वरूपां जयेम तया विश्वाः पृतना अभि ष्याम॥
verses.tr: anuvratā rohiṇī rohitasya sūriḥ suvarṇā bṛhatī suvarcāḥ tayā vājān viśvarūpāṃ jayema tayā viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhi ṣyāma
verses.en: Golden, refulgent, lofty is the Lady, Rohini, Rohita's devoted Consort. Through her may we win various spoil and booty, through her be conquerors in every battle,

verses.sa:
इदं सदो रोहिणी रोहितस्यासौ पन्थाः पृषती येन याति ।
तां गन्धर्वाः कश्यपा उन्नयन्ति तां रक्षन्ति कवयोऽप्रमादम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ sado rohiṇī rohitasyāsau panthāḥ pṛṣatī yena yāti tāṃ gandharvāḥ kaśyapā unnayanti tāṃ rakṣanti kavayo'pramādam
verses.en: Rohita's seat is Rohini before us: that is the path the speckled Mare pursueth. Kasyapas and Gandharvas lead her upward, and heavenly sages ever watch and guard her.

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्याश्वा हरयः केतुमन्तः सदा वहन्त्यमृताः सुखं रथम्।
घृतपावा रोहितो भ्राजमानो दिवं देवः पृषतीमा विवेश॥
verses.tr: sūryasyāśvā harayaḥ ketumantaḥ sadā vahantyamṛtāḥ sukhaṃ ratham ghṛtapāvā rohito bhrājamāno divaṃ devaḥ pṛṣatīmā viveśa
verses.en: Surya's bay steeds refulgent and immortal draw the light-rolling chariot on for ever. Drinker of fatness, Rohita, resplendent, hath entered into various-coloured heaven,

verses.sa:
यो रोहितो वृषभस्तिग्मशृङ्गः पर्यग्निं परि सूर्यं बभूव ।
यो विष्टभ्नाति पृथिवीं दिवं च तस्माद् देवा अधि सृष्टीः सृजन्ते॥
verses.tr: yo rohito vṛṣabhastigmaśṛṅgaḥ paryagniṃ pari sūryaṃ babhūva yo viṣṭabhnāti pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca tasmād devā adhi sṛṣṭīḥ sṛjante
verses.en: Rohita, Bull whose horns are sharply pointed, superior of Agni and of Surya, He who supports the sundered earth and heaven,—from him the Gods effect their own creations,

verses.sa: रोहितो दिवमारुहन्महतः पर्यर्णवात्। सर्वा रुरोह रोहितो रुहः॥
verses.tr: rohito divamāruhanmahataḥ paryarṇavāt sarvā ruroha rohito ruhaḥ
verses.en: Rohita rose to heaven from mighty ocean, Rohita rose and clomb all steeps and rises.

verses.sa:
वि मिमीष्व पयस्वतीं घृताचीं देवानां धेनुरनपस्पृगेषा।
इन्द्रः सोमं पिबतु क्षेमो अस्त्वग्निः प्र स्तौतु वि मृधो नुदस्व॥
verses.tr: vi mimīṣva payasvatīṃ ghṛtācīṃ devānāṃ dhenuranapaspṛgeṣā indraḥ somaṃ pibatu kṣemo astvagniḥ pra stautu vi mṛdho nudasva
verses.en: Prepare the Milky One who teems with fatness: she is the Gods' never-reluctant milch-cow. Indra drink Soma: ours be peace and safety. Let Agni lead the laud, and chase our foemen.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्निः समिधानो घृतवृद्धो घृताहुतः ।
अभीषाड् विश्वाषाडग्निः सपत्नान् हन्तु ये मम॥
verses.tr: samiddho agniḥ samidhāno ghṛtavṛddho ghṛtāhutaḥ abhīṣāḍ viśvāṣāḍagniḥ sapatnān hantu ye mama
verses.en: Both kindling and inflamed, adored with butter and enhanced thereby, May conquering Agni, conqueror of all, destroy mine enemies,

verses.sa:
हन्त्वेनान् प्र दहत्वरिर्यो नः पृतन्यति ।
क्रव्यादाग्निना वयं सपत्नान् प्र दहामसि॥
verses.tr: hantvenān pra dahatvariryo naḥ pṛtanyati kravyādāgninā vayaṃ sapatnān pra dahāmasi
verses.en: Let him smite down in death and burn the foeman who attacketh me. Our adversaries we consume through Agni the Carnivorous,

verses.sa:
अवाचीनानव जहीन्द्र वज्रेण बाहुमान्।
अधा सपत्नान् मामकानग्नेस्तेजोभिरादिषि॥
verses.tr: avācīnānava jahīndra vajreṇa bāhumān adhā sapatnān māmakānagnestejobhirādiṣi
verses.en: Beat them down, Indra, with thy bolt, beat them down, mighty with thine arm. I through the energy and force of Agni have secured my foes.

verses.sa:
अग्ने सपत्नानधरान् पादयास्मद् व्यथया सजातमुत्पिपानं बृहस्पते ।
इन्द्राग्नी मित्रावरुणावधरे पद्यन्तामप्रतिमन्यूयमानाः॥
verses.tr: agne sapatnānadharān pādayāsmad vyathayā sajātamutpipānaṃ bṛhaspate indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāvadhare padyantāmapratimanyūyamānāḥ
verses.en: Cast down our foes beneath our feet, O Agni. Brihaspati, oppress our rebel kinsman, Low let them fall, O Indra-agni, Mitra-varuna, powerless to show their anger.

verses.sa:
उद्यंस्त्वं देव सूर्य सपत्नानव मे जहि ।
अवैनानश्मना जहि ते यन्त्वधमं तमः॥
verses.tr: udyaṃstvaṃ deva sūrya sapatnānava me jahi avainānaśmanā jahi te yantvadhamaṃ tamaḥ
verses.en: Ascending up on high, O God, O Surya, drive my foes away. Yea, beat them backward with the stone: to deepest darkness let them go,

verses.sa:
वत्सो विराजो वृषभो मतीनामा रुरोह शुक्रपृष्ठोऽन्तरिक्षम्।
घृतेनार्कमभ्यऽर्चन्ति वत्सं ब्रह्म सन्तं ब्रह्मणा वर्धयन्ति॥
verses.tr: vatso virājo vṛṣabho matīnāmā ruroha śukrapṛṣṭho'ntarikṣam ghṛtenārkamabhya'rcanti vatsaṃ brahma santaṃ brahmaṇā vardhayanti
verses.en: Calf of Viraj, the Bull of prayers and worship, white-booked, he hath gone up to air s mid-region, Singing, they hymn the Calf, with gifts of butter: him who is Brahma they exalt with Brahma.

verses.sa:
दिवं च रोह पृथिवीं च रोह राष्ट्रं च रोह द्रविणं च रोह ।
प्रजां च रोहामृतं च रोह रोहितेन तन्वं१ सं स्पृशस्व॥
verses.tr: divaṃ ca roha pṛthivīṃ ca roha rāṣṭraṃ ca roha draviṇaṃ ca roha prajāṃ ca rohāmṛtaṃ ca roha rohitena tanvaṃ1 saṃ spṛśasva
verses.en: Rise up to earth, rise up to heaven above it; rise up to opulence, rise up to kingship. Rise up to offspring, rise to life immortal; rise, and with Rohita unite thy body,

verses.sa:
ये देवा राष्ट्रभृतोऽभितो यन्ति सूर्यम्।
तैष्टे रोहितः संविदानो राष्ट्रं दधातु सुमनस्यमानः॥
verses.tr: ye devā rāṣṭrabhṛto'bhito yanti sūryam taiṣṭe rohitaḥ saṃvidāno rāṣṭraṃ dadhātu sumanasyamānaḥ
verses.en: With all the Gods who circle round the Sun, upholding royal sway, With all of these may Rohita accordant, give sovranty to thee with friendly spirit.

verses.sa:
उत् त्वा यज्ञा ब्रह्मपूता वहन्त्यध्वगतो हरयस्त्वा वहन्ति ।
तिरः समुद्रमति रोचसेऽर्णवम्॥
verses.tr: ut tvā yajñā brahmapūtā vahantyadhvagato harayastvā vahanti tiraḥ samudramati rocase'rṇavam
verses.en: Cleansed by prayer, sacrifices bear thee upward: bay coursers, ever travelling, conyey thee; Thy light shines over sea and billowy ocean,

verses.sa:
रोहिते द्यावापृथिवी अधि श्रिते वसुजिति गोजिति संधनाजिति ।
सहस्रं यस्य जनिमानि सप्त च वोचेयं ते नाभिं भुवनस्याधि मज्मनि॥
verses.tr: rohite dyāvāpṛthivī adhi śrite vasujiti gojiti saṃdhanājiti sahasraṃ yasya janimāni sapta ca voceyaṃ te nābhiṃ bhuvanasyādhi majmani
verses.en: Rohita, conqueror of cows and riches and gathered spoil, is heaven's and earth's upholder, Over earth's greatness would I tell my kinship with thee who hast a thousand births and seven,

verses.sa:
यशा यासि प्रदिशो दिशश्च यशाः पशूनामुत चर्षणीनाम्।
यशाः पृथिव्या अदित्या उपस्थेऽहं भूयासं सवितेव चारुः॥
verses.tr: yaśā yāsi pradiśo diśaśca yaśāḥ paśūnāmuta carṣaṇīnām yaśāḥ pṛthivyā adityā upasthe'haṃ bhūyāsaṃ saviteva cāruḥ
verses.en: A glorious sight to beasts and men, thou goes glorious to the regions and mid-regions, On earth's, on Aditi's bosom, bright with glory. Fain would I equal Savitar in beauty.

verses.sa:
अमुत्र सन्निह वेत्थेतः संस्तानि पश्यसि ।
इतः पश्यन्ति रोचनं दिवि सूर्यं विपश्चितम्॥
verses.tr: amutra sanniha vetthetaḥ saṃstāni paśyasi itaḥ paśyanti rocanaṃ divi sūryaṃ vipaścitam
verses.en: Thou, yonder, knowest all things here, when here thou knowest what is there. From here men see the sphere of light, Surya profoundly wise in heaven,

verses.sa:
देवो देवान् मर्चयस्यन्तश्चरस्यर्णवे।
समानमग्निमिन्धते तं विदुः कवयः परे॥
अवः परेण पर एनावरेण पदा वत्सं बिब्रती गौरुदस्थात्।
सा कद्रीची कं स्विदर्धं परागात् क्वऽस्वित् सूते नहि यूथे अस्मिन्॥
verses.tr: devo devān marcayasyantaścarasyarṇave samānamagnimindhate taṃ viduḥ kavayaḥ pare avaḥ pareṇa para enāvareṇa padā vatsaṃ bibratī gaurudasthāt sā kadrīcī kaṃ svidardhaṃ parāgāt kva'svit sūte nahi yūthe asmin
verses.en: A God, thou injurest the Gods: thou movest in the ocean's depth. Men kindle common Agni: him only the higher sages know, i Beneath the upper realm, above this lower, bearing her Calf at foot, the Cow hath risen. Whitherward, to what place hath she departed? Where doth she calve? Not in this herd of cattle,

verses.sa:
एकपदी द्विपदी सा चतुष्पद्यष्टापदी नवपदी बभूवुषी ।
सहस्राक्षरा भुवनस्य पङ्क्तिस्तस्याः समुद्रा अधि वि क्षरन्ति॥
verses.tr: ekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadyaṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī sahasrākṣarā bhuvanasya paṅktistasyāḥ samudrā adhi vi kṣaranti
verses.en: She hath become one-footed. or two-footed, four-footed, or eight-footed or nine-footed, This universe's thousand-syllabled Pankti, Oceans flow forth from her in all directions.

verses.sa:
आरोहन् द्याममृतः प्राव मे वचः ।
उत् त्वा यज्ञा ब्रह्मपूता वहन्त्यध्वगतो हरयस्त्वा वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: ārohan dyāmamṛtaḥ prāva me vacaḥ ut tvā yajñā brahmapūtā vahantyadhvagato harayastvā vahanti
verses.en: Rising to heaven, immortal, hear my calling. Cleansed by prayer, sacrifices bear thee upward, Bay coursers, ever on the road, convey thee,

verses.sa:
वेद तत् ते अमर्त्य यत् त आक्रमणं दिवि।
यत् ते सधस्थं परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: veda tat te amartya yat ta ākramaṇaṃ divi yat te sadhasthaṃ parame vyo'man
verses.en: This, O Immortal One, I know of thee, thy progress to the sky, thy dwelling-place in loftiest heaven,

verses.sa:
सूर्यो द्यां सूर्यः पृथिवीं सूर्य आपोऽति पश्यति ।
सूर्यो भूतस्यैकं चक्षुरा रुरोह दिवं महीम्॥
verses.tr: sūryo dyāṃ sūryaḥ pṛthivīṃ sūrya āpo'ti paśyati sūryo bhūtasyaikaṃ cakṣurā ruroha divaṃ mahīm
verses.en: Beyond the sky, beyond the Earth looks Surya, and beyond the floods, The single eye of all that is, to mighty heaven hath he arisen.

verses.sa:
उर्वीरासन् परिधयो वेदिर्भूमिरकल्पत ।
तत्रैतावग्नी आधत्त हिमं घ्रंसं च रोहितः॥
verses.tr: urvīrāsan paridhayo vedirbhūmirakalpata tatraitāvagnī ādhatta himaṃ ghraṃsaṃ ca rohitaḥ
verses.en: The earth was made his altar, and the wide expanses were the fence. There Rohita established both these Agnis, fervent heat and cold,

verses.sa:
हिमं घ्रंसं चाधाय यूपान् कृत्वा पर्वतान्।
वर्षाज्यावग्नी ईजाते रोहितस्य स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: himaṃ ghraṃsaṃ cādhāya yūpān kṛtvā parvatān varṣājyāvagnī ījāte rohitasya svarvidaḥ
verses.en: He stablished heat and cold, he made the mountains sacrificial posts, Then both the Agnis, Rohita's who found celestial light, with rain for molten butter, sacrificed.

verses.sa:
स्वर्विदो रोहितस्य ब्रह्मणाग्निः समिध्यते ।
तस्माद् घ्रंसस्तस्माद्धिमस्तस्माद् यज्ञोऽजायत॥
verses.tr: svarvido rohitasya brahmaṇāgniḥ samidhyate tasmād ghraṃsastasmāddhimastasmād yajño'jāyata
verses.en: Rohita's Agni—his who found heaven's light—is kindled with the prayer. From him the heat, from him the cold, from him the sacrifice was born,

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणाग्नी वावृधानौ ब्रह्मवृद्धौ ब्रह्माहुतौ ।
ब्रह्मेद्धावग्नी ईजाते रोहितस्य स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇāgnī vāvṛdhānau brahmavṛddhau brahmāhutau brahmeddhāvagnī ījāte rohitasya svarvidaḥ
verses.en: Both Agnis—Rohita's who found the light of heaven—made strong by prayer, Waxing by prayer, adored with prayer, by prayer enkindled, sacrificed.

verses.sa:
सत्ये अन्यः समाहितोऽप्स्व१न्यः समिध्यते ।
ब्रह्मेद्धावग्नी ईजाते रोहितस्य स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: satye anyaḥ samāhito'psva1nyaḥ samidhyate brahmeddhāvagnī ījāte rohitasya svarvidaḥ
verses.en: One is deposited in Truth, one kindled in the waters: both Agnis of Rohita who found the light are set aflame with prayer.

verses.sa:
यं वातः परि शुम्भति यं वेन्द्रो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
ब्रह्मेद्धावग्नी ईजाते रोहितस्य स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ vātaḥ pari śumbhati yaṃ vendro brahmaṇaspatiḥ brahmeddhāvagnī ījāte rohitasya svarvidaḥ
verses.en: That decked by Wind, and that prepared by Indra Brahmanaspati, Agnis of Rohita who found light, prayer-enkindled, sacrificed.

verses.sa:
वेदिं भूमिं कल्पयित्वा दिवं कृत्वा दक्षिणाम्।
घ्रंसं तदग्निं कृत्वा चकार विश्वमात्मन्वद् वर्षेणाज्येन रोहितः॥
verses.tr: vediṃ bhūmiṃ kalpayitvā divaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇām ghraṃsaṃ tadagniṃ kṛtvā cakāra viśvamātmanvad varṣeṇājyena rohitaḥ
verses.en: Rohita made the earth to be his altar, heaven his Dakshina. Then heat he took for Agni, and with rain for molten butter he created every living thing.

verses.sa:
वर्षमाज्यं घ्रंसो अग्निर्वेदिर्भूमिरकल्पत ।
तत्रैवान् पर्वतानग्निर्गीर्भिरूर्ध्वाँ अकल्पयत्॥
verses.tr: varṣamājyaṃ ghraṃso agnirvedirbhūmirakalpata tatraivān parvatānagnirgīrbhirūrdhvāṃ akalpayat
verses.en: The earth became an altar, heat was Agni, and the butter rain. There Agni made, by song and hymn, these mountains rise and stand erect.

verses.sa:
गीर्भिरूर्ध्वान् कल्पयित्वा रोहितो भूमिमब्रवीत्।
त्वयीदं सर्वं जायतां यद् भूतं यच्च भाव्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: gīrbhirūrdhvān kalpayitvā rohito bhūmimabravīt tvayīdaṃ sarvaṃ jāyatāṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvya'm
verses.en: Then, having made the hills stand up, Rohita spake to Earth and said: In thee let every thing be born, what is and what is yet to be.

verses.sa:
स यज्ञः प्रथमो भूतो भव्यो अजायत ।
तस्माद्ध जज्ञ इदं सर्वं यत् किं चेदं विरोचते रोहितेन ऋषिणाभृतम्॥
verses.tr: sa yajñaḥ prathamo bhūto bhavyo ajāyata tasmāddha jajña idaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiṃ cedaṃ virocate rohitena ṛṣiṇābhṛtam
verses.en: This sacrifice, the first of all, the past, the present, had its birth. From that arose this universe, yea, all this world of brightness, brought by Rohita the heavenly Sage,

verses.sa:
यश्च गां पदा स्फुरति प्रत्यङ् सूर्यं च मेहति ।
तस्य वृश्चामि ते मूलं न च्छायां करवोऽपरम्॥
verses.tr: yaśca gāṃ padā sphurati pratyaṅ sūryaṃ ca mehati tasya vṛścāmi te mūlaṃ na cchāyāṃ karavo'param
verses.en: If thou should kick a cow, or by indecent act offend the Sun, Thy root I sever: nevermore mayst thou cast shadow on the ground.

verses.sa:
यो माभिच्छायमत्येषि मां चाग्निं चान्तरा।
तस्य वृश्चामि ते मूलं न च्छायां करवोऽपरम्॥
verses.tr: yo mābhicchāyamatyeṣi māṃ cāgniṃ cāntarā tasya vṛścāmi te mūlaṃ na cchāyāṃ karavo'param
verses.en: Thou who, between the fire and me, passest across the line of shade, Thy root I sever: nevermore mayst thou cast shadow on the ground.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य देव सूर्य त्वां च मां चान्तरायति ।
दुष्वप्न्यं तस्मिंछमलं दुरितानि च मृज्महे॥
verses.tr: yo adya deva sūrya tvāṃ ca māṃ cāntarāyati duṣvapnyaṃ tasmiṃchamalaṃ duritāni ca mṛjmahe
verses.en: Whoe'er he be who, Surya, God! comes between thee and me to-day, On him we wipe away ill-dream, and troubles, and impurity.

verses.sa:
मा प्र गाम पथो वयं मा यज्ञादिन्द्र सोमिनः ।
मान्त स्थुर्नो अरातयः॥
verses.tr: mā pra gāma patho vayaṃ mā yajñādindra sominaḥ mānta sthurno arātayaḥ
verses.en: Let us not, Indra, leave the path, the Soma-presser's sacrifice. l Let not malignities dwell with us.

verses.sa:
यो यज्ञस्य प्रसाधनस्तन्तुर्देवेष्वाततः ।
तमाहुतमशीमहि॥
verses.tr: yo yajñasya prasādhanastanturdeveṣvātataḥ tamāhutamaśīmahi
verses.en: May we obtain, completely wrought, the thread spun out to reach the Gods, That perfecteth our sacrifice.

sections.label: The glorification of the Sun as Aditya, Surya and Rohita
sections.name: Book 13, hymn 2

verses.sa:
उदस्य केतवो दिवि शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते ।
आदित्यस्य नृचक्षसा महिव्रतस्य मीढुषः॥
verses.tr: udasya ketavo divi śukrā bhrājanta īrate ādityasya nṛcakṣasā mahivratasya mīḍhuṣaḥ
verses.en: Radiant, refulgent in the sky are reared the banners of his light, Aditya's, who beholdeth man, mighty in act and bountiful.

verses.sa:
दिशां प्रज्ञानां स्वरयन्तमर्चिषा सुपक्षमाशुं पतयन्तमर्णवे।
स्तवाम सूर्यं भुवनस्य गोपां यो रश्मिभिर्दिश आभाति सर्वाः॥
verses.tr: diśāṃ prajñānāṃ svarayantamarciṣā supakṣamāśuṃ patayantamarṇave stavāma sūryaṃ bhuvanasya gopāṃ yo raśmibhirdiśa ābhāti sarvāḥ
verses.en: Let us laud him, the whole world's Herdsman, Surya, who with his rays illumines all the regions, Mark of the quarters, brightening them with lustre, swift, mighty-pinioned, flying in the ocean,

verses.sa:
यत् प्राङ् प्रत्यङ् स्वधया यासि शीभं नानारूपे अहनी कर्षि मायया ।
तदादित्य महि तत् ते महि श्रवो यदेको विश्वं परि भूम जायसे॥
verses.tr: yat prāṅ pratyaṅ svadhayā yāsi śībhaṃ nānārūpe ahanī karṣi māyayā tadāditya mahi tat te mahi śravo yadeko viśvaṃ pari bhūma jāyase
verses.en: From west to east thou speedest freely, making by magic day and night of diverse colours, This is Aditya, thy transcendent glory, that thou alone art born through all creation,

verses.sa:
विपश्चितं तरणिं भ्राजमानं वहन्ति यं हरितः सप्त बह्वीः ।
स्रुताद् यमत्त्रिर्दिवमुन्निनाय तं त्वा पश्यन्ति परियान्तमाजिम्॥
verses.tr: vipaścitaṃ taraṇiṃ bhrājamānaṃ vahanti yaṃ haritaḥ sapta bahvīḥ srutād yamattrirdivamunnināya taṃ tvā paśyanti pariyāntamājim
verses.en: Victorious, inspired, and brightly shining, whom seven strong tawny-coloured coursers carry, Whom Atri lifted from the flood to heaven, thus men behold thee as thy course thou runnest,

verses.sa:
मा त्वा दभन् परियान्तमाजिं स्वस्ति दुर्गां अति याहि शीभम्।
दिवं च सूर्य पृथिवीं च देवी महोरात्रे विमिमानो यदेषि॥
verses.tr: mā tvā dabhan pariyāntamājiṃ svasti durgāṃ ati yāhi śībham divaṃ ca sūrya pṛthivīṃ ca devī mahorātre vimimāno yadeṣi
verses.en: Let them not snare thee speeding on thy journey: pass safely, swiftly places hard to traverse,—While measuring out the day and night thou movest—O Surya, even Heaven and Earth the Goddess.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति ते सूर्य चरसे रथाय येनोभावन्तौ परियासि सद्यः ।
यं ते वहन्ति हरितो वहिष्ठाः शतमश्वा यदि वा सप्त बह्वीः॥
verses.tr: svasti te sūrya carase rathāya yenobhāvantau pariyāsi sadyaḥ yaṃ te vahanti harito vahiṣṭhāḥ śatamaśvā yadi vā sapta bahvīḥ
verses.en: Hail to thy rapid car whereon, O Surya, thou cirelest in a moment both the limits, Whirled by thy bay steeds, best of all at drawing, thy hundred horses or seven goodly coursers!

verses.sa:
सुखं सूर्य रथमंशुमन्तं स्योनं सुवह्निमधि तिष्ठ वाजिनम्।
यं ते वहन्ति हरितो वहिष्ठाः शतमश्वा यदि वा सप्त बह्वीः॥
verses.tr: sukhaṃ sūrya rathamaṃśumantaṃ syonaṃ suvahnimadhi tiṣṭha vājinam yaṃ te vahanti harito vahiṣṭhāḥ śatamaśvā yadi vā sapta bahvīḥ
verses.en: Mount thy strong car, O Surya, lightly rolling, drawn by good steeds, propitious, brightly gleaming, Whirled by thy bays, most excellent at drawing, thy hundred horses or seven goodly coursers,

verses.sa:
सप्त सूर्यो हरितो यातवे रथे हिरण्यत्वचसो बृहतीरयुक्त ।
अमोचि शुक्रो रजसः परस्ताद् विधूय देवस्तमो दिवमारुहत्॥
verses.tr: sapta sūryo harito yātave rathe hiraṇyatvacaso bṛhatīrayukta amoci śukro rajasaḥ parastād vidhūya devastamo divamāruhat
verses.en: Surya hath harnessed to his car to draw him seven stately bay steeds gay with wolden housings. The Bright One started from the distant region: dispelling gloom the God hath climbed the heavens.

verses.sa:
उत् केतुना बृहता देव आगन्नपावृक् तमोऽभि ज्योतिरश्रैत्।
दिव्यः सुपर्णः स वीरो व्यऽख्यददितेः पुत्रो भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: ut ketunā bṛhatā deva āgannapāvṛk tamo'bhi jyotiraśrait divyaḥ suparṇaḥ sa vīro vya'khyadaditeḥ putro bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: With lofty banner hath the God gone upward, and introduced the light, expelling darkness. He hath looked round on all the: worlds, the Hero, the son of Aditi, Celestial Eagle.

verses.sa:
उद्यन् रश्मीना तनुषे विश्वा रुपाणि पुष्यसि ।
उभा समुद्रौ क्रतुना वि भासि सर्वांल्लोकान् परिभूर्भ्राजमानः॥
verses.tr: udyan raśmīnā tanuṣe viśvā rupāṇi puṣyasi ubhā samudrau kratunā vi bhāsi sarvāṃllokān paribhūrbhrājamānaḥ
verses.en: Rising, thou spreadest out thy rays, thou nourishest all shapes and forms. Thou with thy power illumest both the oceans, encompassing all spheres with thy refulgence.

verses.sa:
पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ शिशू क्रीडन्तौ परि यातोऽर्णवम्।
विश्वान्यो भुवना विचष्टे हैरण्यैरन्यं हरितो वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḍantau pari yāto'rṇavam viśvānyo bhuvanā vicaṣṭe hairaṇyairanyaṃ harito vahanti
verses.en: Moving by magic power to east and westward, these two young creatures, sporting, circle ocean. One of the pair beholds all living creatures: with wheels of gold the bay steeds bear the other.

verses.sa:
दिवि त्वात्त्रिरधारयत् सूर्या मासाय कर्तवे ।
स एषि सुधृतस्तपन् विश्वा भूतावचाकशत्॥
verses.tr: divi tvāttriradhārayat sūryā māsāya kartave sa eṣi sudhṛtastapan viśvā bhūtāvacākaśat
verses.en: Atri established thee in heaven, O Surya, to create the month. So on thou goest, firmly held, heating, beholding all that is,

verses.sa:
उभावन्तौ समर्षसि वत्सः संमातराविव ।
नन्वे३तदितः पुरा ब्रह्म देवा अमी विदुः॥
verses.tr: ubhāvantau samarṣasi vatsaḥ saṃmātarāviva nanve3taditaḥ purā brahma devā amī viduḥ
verses.en: As the Calf both his parents so thou joinest both the distant bounds, Surely the Gods up yonder knew this sacred mystery long ago,

verses.sa:
यत् समुद्रमनु श्रितं तत् सिषासति सूर्यः ।
अध्वास्य विततो महान् पूर्वश्चापरश्च यः॥
verses.tr: yat samudramanu śritaṃ tat siṣāsati sūryaḥ adhvāsya vitato mahān pūrvaścāparaśca yaḥ
verses.en: Surya is eager to obtain all wealth that lies along the sea, Great is the course spread out for him, his eastward and his westward path.

verses.sa:
तं समाप्नोति जूतिभिस्ततो नाप चिकित्सति ।
तेनामृतस्य भक्षं देवानां नाव रुन्धते॥
verses.tr: taṃ samāpnoti jūtibhistato nāpa cikitsati tenāmṛtasya bhakṣaṃ devānāṃ nāva rundhate
verses.en: He finishes his race with speed and never turns his thought aside. Thereby he keeps not from the Gods enjoyment of the Drink of Life.

verses.sa:
उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः ।
दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dṛśe viśvāya sūryam
verses.en: His heralds bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that live, Surya, that all may look on him.

verses.sa:
अप त्ये तायवो यथा नक्षत्रा यन्त्यक्तुभिः ।
सूराय विश्वचक्षसे॥
verses.tr: apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yantyaktubhiḥ sūrāya viśvacakṣase
verses.en: The Constellations pass away; like thieves, departing in the night, Before the all-beholding Sun.

verses.sa:
अदृश्रन्नस्य केतवो वि रश्मयो जनाँ अनु ।
भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा॥
verses.tr: adṛśrannasya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṃ anu bhrājanto agnayo yathā
verses.en: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze,

verses.sa:
तरणिर्विश्वदर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृदसि सूर्य ।
विश्वमा भासि रोचन॥
verses.tr: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya viśvamā bhāsi rocana
verses.en: Swift and all-beautiful art thou, O Surya, maker of the light, Illuming all the radiant realm,

verses.sa:
प्रत्यङ् देवानां विशः प्रत्यङ्ङुदेषि मानुषीः ।
प्रत्यङ् विश्वं स्वर्दृशे॥
verses.tr: pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅudeṣi mānuṣīḥ pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svardṛśe
verses.en: Thou goest to the hosts of Gods, thou comest hither to mankind, Hither, all light to be behold,

verses.sa:
येना पावक चक्षसा भुरण्यन्तं जनाँ अनु ।
त्वं वरुण पश्यसि॥
verses.tr: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṃ anu tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi
verses.en: With that same eye of thine wherewith thou seest, brilliant Varuna, "The active one among mankind,

verses.sa:
वि द्यामेषि रजस्पृथ्वहर्मिमानो अक्तुभिः ।
पश्यन् जन्मानि सूर्य॥
verses.tr: vi dyāmeṣi rajaspṛthvaharmimāno aktubhiḥ paśyan janmāni sūrya
verses.en: Traversing sky and wide mid-air, thou metest with thy beams our days, Sun, seeing all things that have life.

verses.sa:
सप्त त्वा हरितो रथे वहन्ति देव सूर्य ।
शोचिष्केशं विचक्षणम्॥
verses.tr: sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇam
verses.en: Seven bay steeds harnessed to thy car bear thee, O thou far-seeing One, God, Surya, with the radiant hair,

verses.sa:
अयुक्त सप्त शुन्ध्युवः सूरो रथस्य नप्त्यः ।
ताभिर्याति स्वयुक्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ tābhiryāti svayuktibhiḥ
verses.en: Surya hath yoked the pure bright seven, the daughters of the ear, with these, His own dear team, he travelleth.

verses.sa:
रोहितो दिवमारुहत् तपसा तपस्वी।
स योनिमैति स उ जायते पुनः स देवानामधिपतिर्बभूव॥
verses.tr: rohito divamāruhat tapasā tapasvī sa yonimaiti sa u jāyate punaḥ sa devānāmadhipatirbabhūva
verses.en: Devout, aflame with fervent heat, Rohita hath gone up to heaven. He is re-born, returning to his birthplace, and hath become the Gods' imperial ruler,

verses.sa:
यो विश्वचर्षणिरुत विश्वतोमुखो यो विश्वतस्पाणिरुत विश्वतस्पृथः ।
सं बाहुभ्यां भरति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावापृथिवी जनयन् देव एकः॥
verses.tr: yo viśvacarṣaṇiruta viśvatomukho yo viśvataspāṇiruta viśvataspṛthaḥ saṃ bāhubhyāṃ bharati saṃ patatrairdyāvāpṛthivī janayan deva ekaḥ
verses.en: Dear unto all men, facing all directions, with hands and palms on every side extended, He, the sole God, engendering earth and heaven, beareth them with his wings and arms together.

verses.sa:
एकपाद् द्विपदो भूयो वि चक्रमे द्विपात् त्रिपादमभ्येऽति पश्चात्।
द्विपाद्ध षट्पदो भूयो वि चक्रमे त एकपदस्तन्वं१ समासते॥
verses.tr: ekapād dvipado bhūyo vi cakrame dvipāt tripādamabhye'ti paścāt dvipāddha ṣaṭpado bhūyo vi cakrame ta ekapadastanvaṃ1 samāsate
verses.en: The single-footed hath outstepped the biped, the. biped overtakes the triple-footed, The biped hath outstridden the six-footed: these sit around the single-footed's body,

verses.sa:
अतन्द्रो यास्यन् हरितो यदास्थाद् द्वे रूपे कृणुते रोचमानः ।
केतुमानुद्यन्त्सहमानो रजांसि विश्वा आदित्य प्रवतो वि भासि॥
verses.tr: atandro yāsyan harito yadāsthād dve rūpe kṛṇute rocamānaḥ ketumānudyantsahamāno rajāṃsi viśvā āditya pravato vi bhāsi
verses.en: When he, unwearied, fain to go, hath mounted his bays, he makes two colours, brightly shining. Rising with banners, conquering the regions, thou sendest light through all the floods, Aditya.

verses.sa:
बण्महां असि सूर्य बडादित्य महां असि ।
महांस्ते महतो महिमा त्वमादित्य महां असि॥
verses.tr: baṇmahāṃ asi sūrya baḍāditya mahāṃ asi mahāṃste mahato mahimā tvamāditya mahāṃ asi
verses.en: Verily, Surya, thou art great: truly, Aditya, thou art great. Great is thy grandeur, Mighty One: thou, O Aditya, thou art great.

verses.sa:
रोचसे दिवि रोचसे अन्तरिक्षे पतङ्ग पृथिव्यां रोचसे रोचसे अप्स्व१न्तः ।
उभा समुद्रौ रुच्या व्याऽपिथ देवो देवासि महिषः स्वर्जित्॥
verses.tr: rocase divi rocase antarikṣe pataṅga pṛthivyāṃ rocase rocase apsva1ntaḥ ubhā samudrau rucyā vyā'pitha devo devāsi mahiṣaḥ svarjit
verses.en: In heaven, O Bird, and in mid-air thou shinest: thou shinest on the earth and in the waters. Thou hast pervaded both the seas with splendour: a God art thou, O God, light-winner, mighty.

verses.sa:
अर्वाङ् परस्तात् प्रयतो व्यध्व आशुर्विपश्चित् पतयन् पतङ्गः ।
विष्णुर्विचित्तः शवसाधितिष्ठन् प्र केतुना सहते विश्वमेजत्॥
verses.tr: arvāṅ parastāt prayato vyadhva āśurvipaścit patayan pataṅgaḥ viṣṇurvicittaḥ śavasādhitiṣṭhan pra ketunā sahate viśvamejat
verses.en: Soaring in mid-course hither from the distance, fleet and inspired, the Bird that flies above us, With might advancing Vishnu manifested, he conquers all that moves with radiant banner:

verses.sa:
चित्रश्चिकित्वान् महिषः सुपर्ण आरोचयन् रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम्।
अहोरात्रे परि सूर्यं वसाने प्रास्य विश्वा तिरतो वीर्याऽणि॥
verses.tr: citraścikitvān mahiṣaḥ suparṇa ārocayan rodasī antarikṣam ahorātre pari sūryaṃ vasāne prāsya viśvā tirato vīryā'ṇi
verses.en: Brilliant, observant, mighty Lord, an Eagle illuming both the spheres and air between them, Day and the Night, clad in the robes of Sarya, spread forth more widely all his hero powers,

verses.sa:
तिग्मो विभ्राजन् तन्वं१ शिशानोऽरंगमासः प्रवतो रराणः ।
ज्योतिष्मान् पक्षी महिषो वयोधा विश्वा आस्थात् प्रदिशः कल्पमानः॥
verses.tr: tigmo vibhrājan tanvaṃ1 śiśāno'raṃgamāsaḥ pravato rarāṇaḥ jyotiṣmān pakṣī mahiṣo vayodhā viśvā āsthāt pradiśaḥ kalpamānaḥ
verses.en: Flaming and radiant, strengthening his body, bestowing floods that promptly come to meet us, He, luminous, winged, mighty, strength-bestower, hath mounted all the regions as he forms them.

verses.sa:
चित्रं देवानां केतुरनीकं ज्योतिष्मान् प्रदिशः सूर्य उद्यन्।
दिवाकरोऽति द्युम्नैस्तमांसि विश्वातारीद् दुरितानि शुक्रः॥
verses.tr: citraṃ devānāṃ keturanīkaṃ jyotiṣmān pradiśaḥ sūrya udyan divākaro'ti dyumnaistamāṃsi viśvātārīd duritāni śukraḥ
verses.en: Bright presence of the Gods, the luminous herald, Surya hath mounted the celestial regions, Day's maker, he hath shone away the darkness, and radiant, passed o'er places hard to traverse,

verses.sa:
चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः ।
आप्राद् द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च॥
verses.tr: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ āprād dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca
verses.en: He hath gone up on high, the Gods' bright presence, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni, The Soul of all that moveth not or moveth, Surya hath filled the earth and air and heaven.

verses.sa:
उच्चा पतन्तमरुणं सुपर्णं मध्ये दिवस्तरणिं भ्राजमानम्।
पश्याम त्वा सवितारं यमाहुरजस्रं ज्योतिर्यदविन्ददत्त्रिः॥
verses.tr: uccā patantamaruṇaṃ suparṇaṃ madhye divastaraṇiṃ bhrājamānam paśyāma tvā savitāraṃ yamāhurajasraṃ jyotiryadavindadattriḥ
verses.en: High in the midst of heaven may we behold thee whom men call Savitar, the bright red Eagle, Soaring and speeding on thy way, refulgent, unwasting light which Atri erst discovered.

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृष्ठे धावमानं सुपर्णमदित्याः पुत्रं नाथकाम उप यामि भीतः ।
स नः सूर्य प्र तिर दीर्घमायुर्मा रिषाम सुमतौ ते स्याम॥
verses.tr: divaspṛṣṭhe dhāvamānaṃ suparṇamadityāḥ putraṃ nāthakāma upa yāmi bhītaḥ sa naḥ sūrya pra tira dīrghamāyurmā riṣāma sumatau te syāma
verses.en: Him, Son of Aditi, an Eagle hasting along heaven's height, I supplicate in terror. As such prolong our lengthened life, O Surya: may we, unharmed, enjoy thy gracious favour.

verses.sa:
सहस्राह्ण्यं वियतावस्य पक्षौ हरेर्हंसस्य पततः स्वर्गम्।
स देवान्त्सर्वानुरस्युपदद्य संपश्यन् याति भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: sahasrāhṇyaṃ viyatāvasya pakṣau harerhaṃsasya patataḥ svargam sa devāntsarvānurasyupadadya saṃpaśyan yāti bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: This gold hued Hansa's wings, soaring to heaven, spread o'er a thousand days' continued journey, Supporting all the Gods upon his bosom, he goes his way beholding every creature.

verses.sa:
रोहितः कालो अभवद् रोहितोऽग्रे प्रजापतिः ।
रोहितो यज्ञानां मुखं रोहितः स्व१राभरत्॥
verses.tr: rohitaḥ kālo abhavad rohito'gre prajāpatiḥ rohito yajñānāṃ mukhaṃ rohitaḥ sva1rābharat
verses.en: Rohita, in primeval days Prajapati, was, after, Timel Mouth of all sacrifices, be, Rohita, brought celestia, light.

verses.sa:
रोहितो लोको अभवद् रोहितोऽत्यतपद् दिवम्।
रोहितो रश्मिभिर्भूमिं समुद्रमनु सं चरत्॥
verses.tr: rohito loko abhavad rohito'tyatapad divam rohito raśmibhirbhūmiṃ samudramanu saṃ carat
verses.en: He, Rohita, became the world: Rohita gave the heaven its heat. Rohita with his beams of light travelled along the earth and sea.

verses.sa:
सर्वा दिशः समचरद् रोहितोऽधिपतिर्दिवः ।
दिवं समुद्रमाद् भूमिं सर्वं भूतं वि रक्षति॥
verses.tr: sarvā diśaḥ samacarad rohito'dhipatirdivaḥ divaṃ samudramād bhūmiṃ sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ vi rakṣati
verses.en: To all the regions Rohita came, the imperial Lord of heaven. He watches over ocean, heaven, and earth and all existing things.

verses.sa:
आरोहन्छुक्रो बृहतीरतन्द्रो द्वे रूपे कृणुते रोचमानः ।
चित्रश्चिकित्वान् महिषो वातमाया यावतो लोकानभि यद् विभाति॥
verses.tr: ārohanchukro bṛhatīratandro dve rūpe kṛṇute rocamānaḥ citraścikitvān mahiṣo vātamāyā yāvato lokānabhi yad vibhāti
verses.en: Mounting the lofty ones, he, bright, unwearied, splendidly shining, makes two separate colours, While through all worlds that are he sends his lustre radiant, observant, mighty, wind-approacher,

verses.sa:
अभ्य१न्यदेति पर्यन्यदस्यतेऽहोरात्राभ्यां महिषः कल्पमानः ।
सूर्यं वयं रजसि क्षियन्तं गातुविदं हवामहे नाधमानाः॥
verses.tr: abhya1nyadeti paryanyadasyate'horātrābhyāṃ mahiṣaḥ kalpamānaḥ sūryaṃ vayaṃ rajasi kṣiyantaṃ gātuvidaṃ havāmahe nādhamānāḥ
verses.en: One form comes on, the other is reverted: to day and night the Strong One shapes and fits him, With humble prayer for aid we call on Sarya, who knows the way, whose home is in the region.

verses.sa:
पृथिवीप्रो महिषो नाधमानस्य गातुरदब्धचक्षुः परि विश्वं बभूव ।
विश्वं संपश्यन्त्सुविदत्रो यजत्र इदं शृणोतु यदहं ब्रवीमि॥
verses.tr: pṛthivīpro mahiṣo nādhamānasya gāturadabdhacakṣuḥ pari viśvaṃ babhūva viśvaṃ saṃpaśyantsuvidatro yajatra idaṃ śṛṇotu yadahaṃ bravīmi
verses.en: The suppliant's way, filling the earth, the Mighty eirclebh the world with eye that none deceiveth, May he, all-seeing, well-disposed and holy, give ear and listen to the word I utter,

verses.sa:
पर्यस्य महिमा पृथिवीं समुद्रं ज्योतिषा विभ्राजन् परि द्यामन्तरिक्षम्।
सर्वं संपश्यन्त्सुविदत्रो यजत्र इदं शृणोतु यदहं ब्रवीमि॥
verses.tr: paryasya mahimā pṛthivīṃ samudraṃ jyotiṣā vibhrājan pari dyāmantarikṣam sarvaṃ saṃpaśyantsuvidatro yajatra idaṃ śṛṇotu yadahaṃ bravīmi
verses.en: Blazing with light his majesty hath compassed ocean and earth and heaven and air's mid-region, May he, all-seeing, well-disposed and holy, give ear and listen to the word I utter,

verses.sa:
अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम्।
यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सिस्रते नाकमच्छ॥
verses.tr: abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenumivāyatīmuṣāsam yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākamaccha
verses.en: Agni is wakened by 'the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow, Like young trees shooting up on high their branche, his flames are mounting to the vault of heaven.

verses.sa:
य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जजान यो द्रापिं कृत्वा भुवनानि वस्ते ।
यस्मिन् क्षियन्ति प्रदिशः षडुर्वीर्याः पतङ्गो अनु विचाकशीति तस्य देवस्य। क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna yo drāpiṃ kṛtvā bhuvanāni vaste yasmin kṣiyanti pradiśaḥ ṣaḍurvīryāḥ pataṅgo anu vicākaśīti tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: He who engendered these, the earth and heaven, who made the worlds the mantle that he weareth, In whom abide the six wide-spreading regions through which the Bird's keen vision penetrated, This God is wroth offended by the sinner who wrongs the Brahman who hath gained this knowledge. Agitate him, O Rohita; destroy him: entangle in thy snares the Brahman's tyrant.

verses.sa:
यस्माद् वाता ऋतुथा पवन्ते यस्मात् समुद्रा अधि विक्षरन्ति तस्य देवस्य। क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yasmād vātā ṛtuthā pavante yasmāt samudrā adhi vikṣaranti tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: He from whom winds blow pure in ordered season, from whom the seas flow forth in all directions, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
यो मारयति प्राणयति यस्मात् प्राणन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा तस्य देवस्य।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yo mārayati prāṇayati yasmāt prāṇanti bhuvanāni viśvā tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: He who takes life away, he who bestows it; from whom comes breath to every living creature, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
यः प्राणेन द्यावापृथिवी तर्पयत्यपानेन समुद्रस्य जठरं यः पिपर्ति तस्य देवस्य क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prāṇena dyāvāpṛthivī tarpayatyapānena samudrasya jaṭharaṃ yaḥ piparti tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: Who with the breath he draws sates earth and heaven, with expiration fills the ocean's belly, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् विराट् परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिरग्निर्वैश्वानरः सह पङ्क्त्या श्रितः ।
यः परस्य प्राणं परमस्य तेज आददे तस्य देवस्य।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yasmin virāṭ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiragnirvaiśvānaraḥ saha paṅktyā śritaḥ yaḥ parasya prāṇaṃ paramasya teja ādade tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: In whom Viraj, Prajapati, Parameshthin, Agni Vaisvanara abide with Pankti. He who hath taken to himself the breathing of the Supreme, the vigour of the Highest, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् षडुर्वीः पञ्च दिशो अधि श्रिताश्चतस्र आपो यज्ञस्य त्रयोऽक्षराः ।
यो अन्तरा रोदसी क्रुद्धश्चक्षुषैक्षत तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yasmin ṣaḍurvīḥ pañca diśo adhi śritāścatasra āpo yajñasya trayo'kṣarāḥ yo antarā rodasī kruddhaścakṣuṣaikṣata tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: On whom rest six expanses and five regions, four Waters, and three syllables of worship, He who hath looked between both spheres in anger, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
यो अन्नादो अन्नपतिर्बभूव ब्रह्मणस्पतिरुत यः ।
भूतो भविष्यद् भुवनस्य यस्पतिस्तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yo annādo annapatirbabhūva brahmaṇaspatiruta yaḥ bhūto bhaviṣyad bhuvanasya yaspatistasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: He who, consuming food, become its master, the ord of Prayer, the Regent of Devotion, The world's Lord, present and to be hereafter, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रैर्विमितं त्रिंशदङ्गं त्रयोदशं मासं यो निर्मिमीते तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: ahorātrairvimitaṃ triṃśadaṅgaṃ trayodaśaṃ māsaṃ yo nirmimīte tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: He who metes out the thirteenth month, constructed with days and nights, containing thirty members, This God, etc,

verses.sa:
कृष्णं नियानं हरयः सुपर्णा अपो वसाना दिवमुत् पतन्ति ।
त आववृत्रन्त्सदनादृतस्य तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divamut patanti ta āvavṛtrantsadanādṛtasya tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: Dark the descent; the strong-winged birds are golden: they fly aloft to heaven, enrobed in waters, They have come hither from the seat of Order, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
यत् ते चन्द्रं कश्यप रोचनावद् यत् संहितं पुष्कलं चित्रभानु।
यस्मिन्त्सूर्या आर्पिताः सप्त साकं तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yat te candraṃ kaśyapa rocanāvad yat saṃhitaṃ puṣkalaṃ citrabhānu yasmintsūryā ārpitāḥ sapta sākaṃ tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: What silver, Kasyapa, thou hast refulgent, what brightly-shining lotus-flower collected, Wherein are gathered seven Suns together, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
बृहदेनमनु वस्ते पुरस्ताद् रथंतरं प्रति गृह्णाति पश्चात्।
ज्योतिर्वसाने सदमप्रमादं तस्य देवस्य।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: bṛhadenamanu vaste purastād rathaṃtaraṃ prati gṛhṇāti paścāt jyotirvasāne sadamapramādaṃ tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: In front the Brihat-saman is his mantle, and from behind Rathantara enfolds him, Ever with care robing themselves in splendour. This God etc.

verses.sa:
बृहदन्यतः पक्ष आसीद् रथंतरमन्यतः सबले सध्रीची ।
यद् रोहितमजनयन्त देवास्तस्य देवस्य।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: bṛhadanyataḥ pakṣa āsīd rathaṃtaramanyataḥ sabale sadhrīcī yad rohitamajanayanta devāstasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: One of his wings was Brihat, and the other Rathantara, vigorous with one same purpose, What time the Gods gave Rohita his being, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
स वरुणः सायमग्निर्भवति स मित्रो भवति प्रातरुद्यन्।
स सविता भूत्वान्तरिक्षेण याति स इन्द्रो भूत्वा तपति मध्यतो दिवं तस्य देवस्य।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: sa varuṇaḥ sāyamagnirbhavati sa mitro bhavati prātarudyan sa savitā bhūtvāntarikṣeṇa yāti sa indro bhūtvā tapati madhyato divaṃ tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: At evening he is Varuna and Agni, ascending in the morning he is Mitra. As Savitar, he moves through air's mid region, as Indra warms the heavens from the centre, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
सहस्राह्ण्यं वियतावस्य पक्षौ हरेर्हंसस्य पततः स्वर्गम्।
स देवान्त्सर्वानुरस्युपदद्य संपश्यन् याति भुवनानि विश्वा तस्य देवस्य।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: sahasrāhṇyaṃ viyatāvasya pakṣau harerhaṃsasya patataḥ svargam sa devāntsarvānurasyupadadya saṃpaśyan yāti bhuvanāni viśvā tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: This gold-hued Hansa's wings, soaring to heaven spread o'er a thousand days' continued journey. Supporting all the Gods upon his bosom, he goes his way beholding every creature. This God, etc,

verses.sa:
अयं स देवो अप्स्व१न्तः सहस्रमूलः पुरुशाको अत्त्रिः ।
य इदं विश्वं भुवनं जजान तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sa devo apsva1ntaḥ sahasramūlaḥ puruśāko attriḥ ya idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: This is the God who dwells within the waters, the thousand-rooted, many-powered Atri, He who brought all this world into existence. This God, etc,

verses.sa:
शुक्रं वहन्ति हरयो रघुष्यदो देवं दिवि वर्चसा भ्राजमानम्।
यस्योर्ध्वा दिवं तन्व१स्तपन्त्यर्वाङ् सुवर्णैः पटरैर्वि भाति तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: śukraṃ vahanti harayo raghuṣyado devaṃ divi varcasā bhrājamānam yasyordhvā divaṃ tanva1stapantyarvāṅ suvarṇaiḥ paṭarairvi bhāti tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: With flying feet his tawny coursers carry the bright God through the sky, aglow with splendour, Whose limbs uplifted fire and heat the heavens: hither he shines with beams of golden colour, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
येनादित्यान् हरितः सम्वहन्ति येन यज्ञेन बहवो यन्ति प्रजानन्तः ।
यदेकं ज्योतिर्बहुधा विभाति तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: yenādityān haritaḥ samvahanti yena yajñena bahavo yanti prajānantaḥ yadekaṃ jyotirbahudhā vibhāti tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: He beside whom his bay steeds bear the Adityas, by whom as sacrifice go many knowing, The sole light shining spread through various places, This God. etc.

verses.sa:
सप्त युञ्जन्ति रथमेकचक्रमेको अश्वो वहति सप्तनामा ।
त्रिनाभि चक्रमजरमनर्वं यत्रेमा विश्वा भुवनाधि तस्थुस्तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: sapta yuñjanti rathamekacakrameko aśvo vahati saptanāmā trinābhi cakramajaramanarvaṃ yatremā viśvā bhuvanādhi tasthustasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: The seven make the one-wheeled chariot ready: bearing seven names the single courser draws it, The wheel, three-naved, is sound and undecaying: thereon these worlds of life are all dependent. This God, etc.

verses.sa:
अष्टधा युक्तो वहति वह्निरुग्रः पिता देवानां जनिता मतीनाम्।
ऋतस्य तन्तुं मनसा मिमानः सर्वा दिशः पवते मातरिश्वा तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: aṣṭadhā yukto vahati vahnirugraḥ pitā devānāṃ janitā matīnām ṛtasya tantuṃ manasā mimānaḥ sarvā diśaḥ pavate mātariśvā tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: Eight times attached the potent Courser draws it, Sire of the Gods, father of hymns and praises. So Matarisvan, measuring in spirit the thread of Order, purifies all regains, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
संयञ्चं तन्तुं प्रदिशोऽनु सर्वा अन्तर्गायत्र्याममृतस्य गर्भे तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: saṃyañcaṃ tantuṃ pradiśo'nu sarvā antargāyatryāmamṛtasya garbhe tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: The thread that goes through all celestial quarters within the Gayatri, womb of life eternal. This God, etc.

verses.sa:
निम्रुचस्तिस्रो व्युषो ह तिस्रस्त्रीणि रजांसि दिवो अङ्ग तिस्रः ।
विद्मा ते अग्ने त्रेधा जनित्रं त्रेधा देवानां जनिमानि विद्म तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: nimrucastisro vyuṣo ha tisrastrīṇi rajāṃsi divo aṅga tisraḥ vidmā te agne tredhā janitraṃ tredhā devānāṃ janimāni vidma tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: Three are the settings, three the upward risings; three, are the spaces, yea, and three the heavens. We know thy triple place of birth, O Agni, we know the deities' triple generations.

verses.sa:
वि य और्णोत् पृथिवीं जायमान आ समुद्रमदधादन्तरिक्षे तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: vi ya aurṇot pṛthivīṃ jāyamāna ā samudramadadhādantarikṣe tasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: He who, as soon as born, laid broad earth open, and set the ocean in the air's mid-region, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने क्रतुभिः केतुभिर्हितो३र्कः समिद्ध उदरोचथा दिवि।
किमभ्याऽर्चन् मरुतः पृश्निमातरो यद् रोहितमजनयन्त देवास्तस्य देवस्य।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: tvamagne kratubhiḥ ketubhirhito3rkaḥ samiddha udarocathā divi kimabhyā'rcan marutaḥ pṛśnimātaro yad rohitamajanayanta devāstasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: Thou. Agni, kind with lights and mental powers, hast up in heaven shone as the Sun, enkindled, The Maruts, sons of Prisni, sang his praises what time the Gods gave Rohita his being. This God, etc.

verses.sa:
य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः ।
यो३स्येशे द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदस्तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ yo3syeśe dvipado yaścatuṣpadastasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: Giver of breath, giver of strength and vigour, he whose commandment all the Gods acknowledge, He who is Lord of this, of man and cattle, This God, etc.

verses.sa:
एकपाद् द्विपदो भूयो वि चक्रमे द्विपात् त्रिपादमभ्येऽति पश्चात्।
चतुष्पाच्चक्रे द्विपदामभिस्वरे संपश्यन् पङ्क्तिमुपतिष्ठमानस्तस्य देवस्य ।
क्रुद्धस्यैतदागो य एवं विद्वांसं ब्राह्मणं जिनाति ।
उद् वेपय रोहित प्र क्षिणीहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य प्रति मुञ्च पाशान्॥
verses.tr: ekapād dvipado bhūyo vi cakrame dvipāt tripādamabhye'ti paścāt catuṣpāccakre dvipadāmabhisvare saṃpaśyan paṅktimupatiṣṭhamānastasya devasya kruddhasyaitadāgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti ud vepaya rohita pra kṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya prati muñca pāśān
verses.en: The single-footed hath outstepped the biped, the. biped overtakes the triple-footed. The quadruped hath wrought when bipeds called him, standing and looking on the five collected. This God is wroth offended by the sinner that wrongs the Brahman who hath gained this knowledge. Agitate him, O Rohita; destroy him: entangle in thy snares the Brahman's tyrant. y

verses.sa:
कृष्णायाः पुत्रो अर्जुनो रात्र्या वत्सोऽजायत ।
स ह द्यामधि रोहति रुहो रुरोह रोहितः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇāyāḥ putro arjuno rātryā vatso'jāyata sa ha dyāmadhi rohati ruho ruroha rohitaḥ
verses.en: Born is the darksome Mother's Son, the whitely shining Calf of Night. He, Rohita, ascendeth up to heaven, hath mounted to the heights.

sections.label: A glorification of the Sun as the one only Deity
sections.name: Book 13, hymn 4

verses.sa: स एति सविता स्वऽर्दिवस्पृष्ठेऽवचाकशत्॥
verses.tr: sa eti savitā sva'rdivaspṛṣṭhe'vacākaśat
verses.en: Down looking, on the ridge of sky Savitar goes to highest heaven.

verses.sa: रश्मिभिर्नभ आभृतं महेन्द्र एत्यावृतः॥
verses.tr: raśmibhirnabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra etyāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: To misty cloud filled with his rays Mahendra goes encompassed round.

verses.sa:
स धाता स विधर्ता स वायुर्नभ उच्छ्रितम्।
रश्मिभिर्नभ आभृतं महेन्द्र एत्यावृतः॥
verses.tr: sa dhātā sa vidhartā sa vāyurnabha ucchritam raśmibhirnabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra etyāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: Creator, and Ordainer, he is Vayu, he is lifted cloud,

verses.sa:
सोऽर्यमा स वरुणः स रुद्रः स महादेवः।
रश्मिभिर्नभ आभृतं महेन्द्र एत्यावृतः॥
verses.tr: so'ryamā sa varuṇaḥ sa rudraḥ sa mahādevaḥ raśmibhirnabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra etyāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: Rudra, and Mahadeva, he is Aryaman and Varuna,

verses.sa:
सो अग्निः स उ सूर्यः स उ एव महायमः।
रश्मिभिर्नभ आभृतं महेन्द्र एत्यावृतः॥
verses.tr: so agniḥ sa u sūryaḥ sa u eva mahāyamaḥ raśmibhirnabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra etyāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: Agni is he, and Surya, he is verily Mahayama,

verses.sa:
तं वत्सा उप तिष्ठन्त्येकशीर्षाणो युता दश ।
रश्मिभिर्नभ आभृतं महेन्द्र एत्यावृतः॥
verses.tr: taṃ vatsā upa tiṣṭhantyekaśīrṣāṇo yutā daśa raśmibhirnabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra etyāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: Calves, joined, stand close beside him, ten in number, with one single head.

verses.sa:
पश्चात् प्राञ्च आ तन्वन्ति यदुदेति वि भासति ।
रश्मिभिर्नभ आभृतं महेन्द्र एत्यावृतः॥
verses.tr: paścāt prāñca ā tanvanti yadudeti vi bhāsati raśmibhirnabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra etyāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: From west to east they bend their way: when he mounts up he shines afar.

verses.sa: तस्यैष मारुतो गणः स एति शिक्याकृतः॥
verses.tr: tasyaiṣa māruto gaṇaḥ sa eti śikyākṛtaḥ
verses.en: His are these banded Maruts: they move gathered close like porters' thongs,

verses.sa: रश्मिभिर्नभ आभृतं महेन्द्र एत्यावृतः॥
verses.tr: raśmibhirnabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra etyāvṛtaḥ
verses.en: To misty cloud filled with his rays Mahendra goes encompassed round,

verses.sa: तस्येमे नव कोशा विष्टम्भा नवधा हिताः॥
verses.tr: tasyeme nava kośā viṣṭambhā navadhā hitāḥ
verses.en: His are the nine supports, the casks set in nine several places here.

verses.sa: स प्रजाभ्यो वि पश्यति यच्च प्राणति यच्च न॥
verses.tr: sa prajābhyo vi paśyati yacca prāṇati yacca na
verses.en: He keepeth watch o'er creatures, all that breatheth and that breatheth not.

verses.sa: तमिदं निगतं सहः स एष एक एकवृदेक एव॥
verses.tr: tamidaṃ nigataṃ sahaḥ sa eṣa eka ekavṛdeka eva
verses.en: This conquering might hath entered him, He is the sole, the simple One, the One alone,

verses.sa: एते अस्मिन् देवा एकवृतो भवन्ति॥
verses.tr: ete asmin devā ekavṛto bhavanti
verses.en: In him these Deities become simple and One.

verses.sa: कीर्तिश्च यशश्चाम्भश्च नभश्च ब्राह्मणवर्चसं चान्नं चान्नाद्यं च॥
verses.tr: kīrtiśca yaśaścāmbhaśca nabhaśca brāhmaṇavarcasaṃ cānnaṃ cānnādyaṃ ca
verses.en: Renown and glory, and force and cloud, the Brahman's splendour, and food, and nourishment,

verses.sa: य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: To him who knoweth this God as simple and One.

verses.sa: न द्वितीयो न तृतीयश्चतुर्थो नाप्युच्यते। य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: na dvitīyo na tṛtīyaścaturtho nāpyucyate ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: Neither second nor third, nor yet fourth is he called;

verses.sa: न पञ्चमो न षष्ठः सप्तमो नाप्युच्यते। य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: na pañcamo na ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamo nāpyucyate ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: He is called neither fifth, nor sixth, nor yet seventh;

verses.sa: नाष्टमो न नवमो दशमो नाप्युच्यते । य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: nāṣṭamo na navamo daśamo nāpyucyate ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: He is called neither eighth, nor ninth, nor yet tenth,

verses.sa:
स सर्वस्मै वि पश्यति यच्च प्राणति यच्च न ।
य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: sa sarvasmai vi paśyati yacca prāṇati yacca na ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: He watcheth over creatures, all that breatheth and that breatheth not,

verses.sa:
तमिदं निगतं सहः स एष एक एकवृदेक एव।
य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: tamidaṃ nigataṃ sahaḥ sa eṣa eka ekavṛdeka eva ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: This conquering might hath entered him, He is the sole, the simple One, the One alone.

verses.sa: सर्वे अस्मिन् देवा एकवृतो भवन्ति । य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: sarve asmin devā ekavṛto bhavanti ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: In him these Deities become simple and One.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म च तपश्च कीर्तिश्च यशश्चाम्भश्च नभश्च ब्राह्मणवर्चसं चान्नं चान्नाद्यं च ।
य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: brahma ca tapaśca kīrtiśca yaśaścāmbhaśca nabhaśca brāhmaṇavarcasaṃ cānnaṃ cānnādyaṃ ca ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: Devotion and Religious Fervour, and renown and glory, and force and cloud, the Brahman's splen dour, and food and nourishment,

verses.sa: भूतं च भव्यं च श्रद्धा च रुचिश्च स्वर्गश्च स्वधा च। य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca śraddhā ca ruciśca svargaśca svadhā ca ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: And past and future, and Faith and lustre, and heaven and sweet oblation,

verses.sa: य एतं देवमेकवृतं वेद॥
verses.tr: ya etaṃ devamekavṛtaṃ veda
verses.en: Te him who knoweth this God as simple and One,

verses.sa: स एव मृत्युः सो३ऽमृतं सो३ऽभ्वं१ स रक्षः॥
verses.tr: sa eva mṛtyuḥ so3'mṛtaṃ so3'bhvaṃ1 sa rakṣaḥ
verses.en: He, verily, is death, he is immortality, he is the monster, he is the fiend,

verses.sa: स रुद्रो वसुवनिर्वसुदेये नमोवाके वषट्कारोऽनु संहितः॥
verses.tr: sa rudro vasuvanirvasudeye namovāke vaṣaṭkāro'nu saṃhitaḥ
verses.en: He is Rudra, winner of wealth in the giving of wealth, in uttering homage he is the sacrificial exclamation Vashat duly employed,

verses.sa: तस्येमे सर्वे यातव उप प्रशिषमासते॥
verses.tr: tasyeme sarve yātava upa praśiṣamāsate
verses.en: All sorcerers on earth obey with reverence his high behest.

verses.sa: तस्यामू सर्वा नक्षत्रा वशे चन्द्रमसा सह॥
verses.tr: tasyāmū sarvā nakṣatrā vaśe candramasā saha
verses.en: All constellotions yonder, with the Moon, are subject to his will,

verses.sa: स वा अह्नोऽजायत तस्मादहरजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vā ahno'jāyata tasmādaharajāyata
verses.en: He was brought forth form Day: and Day derives his origin from him.

verses.sa: स वै रात्र्या अजायत तस्माद् रात्रिरजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vai rātryā ajāyata tasmād rātrirajāyata
verses.en: He was brought forth from Night: and Night. derives her origin from him.

verses.sa: स वा अन्तरिक्षादजायत तस्मादन्तरिक्षमजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vā antarikṣādajāyata tasmādantarikṣamajāyata
verses.en: He was produced from Air: and Air derives its origin from him,

verses.sa: स वै वायोरजायत तस्माद् वायुरजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vai vāyorajāyata tasmād vāyurajāyata
verses.en: He was produced from Wind: and Wind derives his origin from him,

verses.sa: स वै दिवोऽजायत तस्माद् द्यौरध्यजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vai divo'jāyata tasmād dyauradhyajāyata
verses.en: From Heaven was he produced: and Heaven derives his origin from him,

verses.sa: स वै दिग्भ्योऽजायत तस्माद् दिशोऽजायन्त॥
verses.tr: sa vai digbhyo'jāyata tasmād diśo'jāyanta
verses.en: He sprang from regions of the sky: from him the heavenly regions sprang.

verses.sa: स वै भूमेरजायत तस्माद् भूमिरजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vai bhūmerajāyata tasmād bhūmirajāyata
verses.en: He is the offspring of the Earth: Earth hath her origin from him.

verses.sa: स वा अग्नेरजायत तस्मादग्निरजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vā agnerajāyata tasmādagnirajāyata
verses.en: He' was produced from fire: and fire derives its origin from him.

verses.sa: स वा अद्भ्योऽजायत तस्मादापोऽजायन्त॥
verses.tr: sa vā adbhyo'jāyata tasmādāpo'jāyanta
verses.en: He is the waters' offspring: and from him the waters were produced,

verses.sa: स वा ऋग्भ्योऽजायत तस्मादृचोऽजायन्त॥
verses.tr: sa vā ṛgbhyo'jāyata tasmādṛco'jāyanta
verses.en: From holy verses was he born: from him the holy verges sprang.

verses.sa: स वै यज्ञादजायत तस्माद् यज्ञोऽजायत॥
verses.tr: sa vai yajñādajāyata tasmād yajño'jāyata
verses.en: He is the son of sacrifice: and sacrifice was born from him.

verses.sa: स यज्ञस्तस्य यज्ञः स यज्ञस्य शिरस्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: sa yajñastasya yajñaḥ sa yajñasya śiraskṛtam
verses.en: Sacrifice, sacrifice's Lord, he was made head of sacrifice.

verses.sa: स स्तनयति स वि द्योतते स उ अश्मानमस्यति॥
verses.tr: sa stanayati sa vi dyotate sa u aśmānamasyati
verses.en: He thundereth, he lighteneth, he casteth down the thunder-stone

verses.sa: पापाय वा भद्राय वा पुरुषायासुराय वा॥
verses.tr: pāpāya vā bhadrāya vā puruṣāyāsurāya vā
verses.en: For misery or happiness, for mortal man or Asura,

verses.sa: यद् वा कृणोष्योषधीर्यद् वा वर्षसि भद्रया यद् वा जन्यमवीवृधः॥
verses.tr: yad vā kṛṇoṣyoṣadhīryad vā varṣasi bhadrayā yad vā janyamavīvṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Whether thou formest growing plants, or sendest, rain for happiness, or hast increased the race of man,

verses.sa: तावांस्ते मघवन् महिमोपो ते तन्वः शतम्॥
verses.tr: tāvāṃste maghavan mahimopo te tanvaḥ śatam
verses.en: Such is thy greatness, liberal Lord! A hundred bodily forms are thine,

verses.sa: उपो ते बध्वे बद्धानि यदि वासि न्यर्बुदम्॥
verses.tr: upo te badhve baddhāni yadi vāsi nyarbudam
verses.en: Millions are in thy million, or thou art a billion in thyself.

verses.sa: भूयानिन्द्रो नमुराद् भूयानिन्द्रासि मृत्युभ्यः॥
verses.tr: bhūyānindro namurād bhūyānindrāsi mṛtyubhyaḥ
verses.en: Stronger than immortality is Indra: stronger thou than deaths;

verses.sa: भूयानरात्याः शच्याः पतिस्त्वमिन्द्रासि विभूः प्रभूरिति त्वोपास्महे वयम्॥
verses.tr: bhūyānarātyāḥ śacyāḥ patistvamindrāsi vibhūḥ prabhūriti tvopāsmahe vayam
verses.en: Yea, stronger than Malignity art thou, O Indra, Lord of Might, Calling thee Master, Sovran Chief, we pay our reverence to thee.

verses.sa: नमस्ते अस्तु पश्यत पश्य मा पश्यत॥
verses.tr: namaste astu paśyata paśya mā paśyata
verses.en: Worship to thee whom all behold! Regard me, thou whom all regard,

verses.sa: अन्नाद्येन यशसा तेजसा ब्राह्मणवर्चसेन॥
verses.tr: annādyena yaśasā tejasā brāhmaṇavarcasena
verses.en: With food, and fame, and vigour, with the splendour af a Brahman's rank,

verses.sa: अम्भो अमो महः सह इति त्वोपास्महे वयम्। नमस्ते॰ । अन्नाद्येन॰॥
verses.tr: ambho amo mahaḥ saha iti tvopāsmahe vayam namaste॰ annādyena॰
verses.en: We pay thee reverence calling thee strength, power, and might, and conquering force.

verses.sa: अम्भो अरुणं रजतं रजः सह इति त्वोपास्महे वयम्। नमस्ते॰ । अन्नाद्येन॰॥
verses.tr: ambho aruṇaṃ rajataṃ rajaḥ saha iti tvopāsmahe vayam namaste॰ annādyena॰
verses.en: We pay thee reverence calling thee red power, the silvery expanse.

verses.sa: उरुः पृथुः सुभूर्भुव इति त्वोपास्महे वयम् । नमस्ते॰ । अन्नाद्येन॰॥
verses.tr: uruḥ pṛthuḥ subhūrbhuva iti tvopāsmahe vayam namaste॰ annādyena॰
verses.en: We pay thee reverence calling thee vast, wide, the good, the universe.

verses.sa: प्रथो वरो व्यचो लोक इति त्वोपास्महे वयम्। नमस्ते॰ । अन्नाद्येन॰॥
verses.tr: pratho varo vyaco loka iti tvopāsmahe vayam namaste॰ annādyena॰
verses.en: We pay thee reverence calling thee extension, compass, width, and world.

verses.sa: भवद्वसुरिदद्वसुः संयद्वसुरायद्वसुरिति त्वोपास्महे वयम्॥
verses.tr: bhavadvasuridadvasuḥ saṃyadvasurāyadvasuriti tvopāsmahe vayam
verses.en: We pay thee reverence, calling thee rich, opulent in this and that, with wealth unceasing and secure,

verses.sa: नमस्ते अस्तु पश्यत पश्य मा पश्यत॥
verses.tr: namaste astu paśyata paśya mā paśyata
verses.en: Worship to thee whom all behold! Regard me, thou whom all regard;

verses.sa: अन्नाद्येन यशसा तेजसा ब्राह्मणवर्चसेन॥
verses.tr: annādyena yaśasā tejasā brāhmaṇavarcasena
verses.en: With food. and fame, and vigour, with the splendour of a Brahman's rank.
